sentences.text:
following:
 Order

This is first bail application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.187/2023, registered at Police Station Pandhana, District Khandwa (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 306 and 34 of IPC.
2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely being implicated in the case.
It is submitted that applicant had not committed abetment of suicide.
In these circumstance, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Deputy Govt. Advocate appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.

It is submitted that dying declaration has been recorded by Tehsildar wherein deceased has categorically stated that she was being repeatedly beaten by her husband and mother-in-law, due to which, she committed suicide.
At the time of death, deceased was pregnant and also having young baby aged about 19 months.
In these circumstances, application be dismissed.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Applicant was married to deceased in year 2020.
There is allegation by her in dying declaration that applicant repeatedly used to beat her.
Due to said reason, she committed suicide.
From dying declaration, it is clear that applicant had not left any other option for deceased except to commit suicide.
6. Considering aforesaid circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
